name: directorist-gutenberg/listings-loop
title: Listings Loop
description: Loop container for listings composition in pages and templates.

directory_type_id.description: The directory type ID for manual listing loop context.

context_mode.description: Context mode for this loop. Inferred uses query context, manual uses selected directory.

instance_id.description: Unique per-loop instance id used for isolated frontend interactions.

listings_columns.description: The number of columns to display listings in.

listings_per_page.description: The number of listings to display per page.

default_view.description: Default loop view: grid, list, or map.
